product_one_liner.value: Talowiz provides AI recruiting agents that automate candidate sourcing, evaluation, interviews and hiring workflows for recruiters and talent-acquisition teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage says Talowiz AI agents autonomously source, evaluate, interview and select talent, while identifying recruiters as the users who do the hiring. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists subscription plans, including a Starter plan at $199 per month. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage presents customer testimonials from GoodGist’s CEO and Vedantu’s AVP HR describing their use of Talowiz for hiring. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/. | named_customers.0: GoodGist’s CEO describes using Talowiz to hire talent, establishing a customer relationship. | named_customers.1: Vedantu’s AVP HR describes the team’s use of Talowiz agents for candidate sourcing and hiring.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company listing reports 15 employees, which falls within the requested 11–20 band. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/talowiz. Public employee counts may be approximate.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The public company profile explicitly identifies San Jose as headquarters, matching the company website’s office address. Confidence is reduced because LinkedIn lists a different US city. Sources: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/talowiz/__V4vPXpp4iMqeXfNhyC1MQbWhedn204GFdweebE_XsPI and https://www.talowiz.ai/. | hq_country: The company website gives a San Jose, United States office address, and its public company profile explicitly identifies San Jose as headquarters. Sources: https://www.talowiz.ai/ and https://tracxn.com/d/companies/talowiz/__V4vPXpp4iMqeXfNhyC1MQbWhedn204GFdweebE_XsPI.

founded_year.notes: The company’s LinkedIn listing states 2022, matching its public Tracxn profile. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/talowiz and https://tracxn.com/d/companies/talowiz/__V4vPXpp4iMqeXfNhyC1MQbWhedn204GFdweebE_XsPI. Confidence is reduced because another directory reports 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains recruiting guidance and product-oriented articles, not at least two engineer-authored posts about building Talowiz’s architecture, infrastructure or ML systems. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/blog.

public_docs.notes: The reviewed homepage navigation and footer do not link to public documentation, a help center or a developer portal; the footer instead links to comparison, pricing, blog and legal pages. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Talowiz’s own Wellfound job board says it has not added any jobs, and the dated jobs listing reports no open roles as of November 9, 2026. Recommended jobs at other employers were excluded. Sources: https://wellfound.com/company/talowiz/jobs and https://www.thejobsmap.com/company/talowiz.

model_provider.notes: The privacy policy explicitly states that Talowiz developed a custom AI model to personalize behavior and content. This identifies its proprietary model without inferring an undisclosed third-party LLM provider. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/privacy-policy.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The privacy policy undertakes to support GDPR data-subject rights and take security measures under Article 32. GDPR is reported as a public compliance undertaking, not an independently audited certification. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/privacy-policy. | compliance_certs.0: Talowiz publicly undertakes GDPR data-subject-rights and Article 32 security obligations; this is a compliance claim rather than proof of external certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook lists one completed Early Stage VC financing and names FortyTwo.VC as an investor. This positive financing evidence prevents classifying Talowiz as having no outside funding, despite other directories lacking round records. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/495789-58. | funding_date: The public financing-history row leaves the round date blank. A supported YYYY-MM date could not be established. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/495789-58. | funding_amount_usd: The public financing-history row identifies a completed round but leaves its amount blank. No supported USD amount was found. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/495789-58.

raised_18mo.notes: Outside financing is documented, but its date is undisclosed. It is therefore not possible to determine whether it occurred within the preceding 18 months, and the absence of dates cannot support false. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/495789-58.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company-specific job board has no Talowiz postings, corroborated by a no-open-roles listing dated November 9, 2026. Thus no current SDR, BDR or account-executive opening is listed. Sources: https://wellfound.com/company/talowiz/jobs and https://www.thejobsmap.com/company/talowiz.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog index’s newest entry is March 6, 2026, before the six-month window. The dated AI-agent introduction is July 31, 2025, also outside that window, and no newer launch announcement was found in the reviewed history. Sources: https://www.talowiz.ai/blog and https://www.talowiz.ai/post/talowiz-ai-agents-vs-other-hiring-tools.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The visible team page lists a cofounder and an employee but does not provide a complete, dated C-level or VP history. No qualifying dated appointment or departure was established, so neither true nor false is sufficiently supported. Source: https://wellfound.com/company/talowiz/people.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Talowiz explicitly says it relies on Mailchimp to manage newsletters and transactional emails, providing a direct marketing-stack signal. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/privacy-policy. The policy’s age limits certainty about continued operational use. | crm_stack_signal.0: The privacy policy explicitly identifies Mailchimp as the system Talowiz uses for newsletters and transactional emails.
